name: Reversa
shortDescription: Plan Reversa adoption and generate install checklists for legacy reverse engineering.
longDescription: Reversa helps developers turn legacy systems into executable, traceable specifications for AI coding agents. This ChatGPT App provides workflow guidance, adoption planning, and review-safe install checklists before users run the Reversa CLI in their own development environment.

testCases.expectedBehavior: The app calls show_reversa_overview and returns the five workflow phases without asking for repository access.

testCases.prompt: Plan Reversa adoption for a Node.js SaaS legacy project with medium risk.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The app calls plan_reversa_adoption and returns a sequence, safeguards, expected artifacts, and the appropriate entry command.

testCases.prompt: Create a Codex install checklist for a TypeScript project with a dirty git tree.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The app calls generate_reversa_install_checklist and warns the user to resolve or document dirty repository state before install.

releaseNotes: Initial review-safe Reversa guidance app with read-only planning tools and dashboard widget.
